name: Bad Girls Club
description: A cast of young women, who recognize that their outrageous behavior has hindered their relationships, careers and lives, are brought together in a beautiful mansion. They claim they want to change, but will living together help them move forward and turn their lives around – or will chaos rule?

videos.title: Afterparty Episode 1
videos.overview: Tanisha Thomas grills season six girls in the first ever "Afterparty" with a questionnaire of the previous episode.

videos.title: Afterparty Episode 2
videos.overview: Tanisha Thomas is joined by Char and Lauren to discuss the episode that has just screened.

videos.title: Flo Gets Married
videos.overview: Florina "Flo" Kaja from season 4 of Bad Girls Club shares her experience with her marriage and pregnancy.

videos.title: Double Trouble: The Twins Speak
videos.overview: Following the "Bad Girls Club Las Vegas" So Social Edition, Tanisha Thomas sits down with the Victor twins to discuss their departure from the BGC House at 10PM ET/PT on Oxygen. Gabi and Dani are joined by their self-proclaimed Bad Boy dad and supportive mother as they dish about their time in Vegas.

videos.title: Makin it to the Mansion, ATL
videos.overview: Former "bad girls" Natalie Nunn and Camilla Pointdexter host a peek at the Season 10 cast of "The Bad Girls Club," which is based in Atlanta.

videos.title: Casting Special
videos.overview: BGC returns with a new twist as four sets of feisty sisters move into the mansion.

videos.title: It's Easier to Be Bad
videos.overview: Leslie gets into a shouting match with Jodie during their first night out on the town; Zara and Ripsi bond while boozing it up, and try yoga...while very intoxicated.

videos.title: A Rude Awakening
videos.overview: Where the last episode left off, Ripsi's temper gets her into big trouble as she unleashes her drunken anger on an unsuspecting Kerry and Jodie. The roommates meet about Ripsi's departure, as the show ends with a cliffhanger.

videos.title: Quick Fix
videos.overview: The others make a decision about Ripsi's future in the Bad Girls house; While Kerry attempts to make time with an attractive pool boy right after her boyfriend leaves, Ripsi's stay in the house comes to a premature end.

videos.title: A Tomik Bomb
videos.overview: While Kerry tries to get David's forgiveness, she becomes closer to Jodie. In the meantime Zara steps on some toes, and appears to have no regards for her boyfriend's feelings as she quests after Tomik.

videos.title: Out with the Old, In with the New
videos.overview: When a new roommate (DeAnn) arrives, she instantly makes friends with everyone except Aimee; Even though her boyfriend is ready and waiting for her back home, Zara persists in hooking up with Tomik behind his back.

videos.title: The Trouble with Boys
videos.overview: Arguing between Tomik and Aimee upsets Zara, but what she finds even more troubling is Aimee's claim that Tomik has a wandering eye. Meanwhile, Jodie becomes very interested in a cute guy.

videos.title: Miss Understanding
videos.overview: When Zara makes a racially-insensitive comment, she manages to find herself on Leslie's bad side; Leslie calls Ty fake for forgiving Zara so quickly.

videos.title: Not a Happy Camper
videos.overview: DeAnn, Kerry, Jodie, and Zara all decide to go on a camping trip, where both DeAnn and Kerry intend to pull a few "playful" pranks upon an unsuspectful Jodie. Meanwhile, back at the house, Ty continues to face troubled waters in her unsteady relationship with her boyfriend, Juan.

videos.title: Smack My Beach Up
videos.overview: Ty and Leslie engage in a boozy night out and return home to a mightily irked Aimee. Later, bad blood boils between Ty and Aimee, who make waves during a beach excursion, ultimately ending Ty's stay in the house. Elsewhere, being home alone gives Jodie and Zara an opportunity to lay bare their sexy and silly sides.

videos.title: And the Walls Came Tomberlin Down
videos.overview: As Leslie tries to cope with her feelings of loneliness after Ty leaves the house, she contemplates whether or not she should do the same.

videos.title: Drop of a Hat
videos.overview: DeAnn makes a pivotal decision, after she enters into a tryst with Pool Boy Steve. In the meantime, Zara looks for revenge against Tomik once his romantic interest in her fades.

videos.title: She Said, She Said
videos.overview: When Zara lets Kerry know that Aimee has been insulting her, not only do the claws come out, it also escalates the feud between Aimee and Zara.

videos.title: Holy Ghost!
videos.overview: Jodie is scolded after she poses in front of religious paintings during a photo shoot; In the meantime, things get eerie when the girls think the house is haunted.

videos.title: What Are Little Girls Made of?
videos.overview: Leslie seeks to leave the world of exotic dancing; Zara's wild antics disrupt her roommates' lives; Leslie's is unsure about her future in the house and ultimately decides to leave.

videos.title: Kiss & Tell
videos.overview: While a shocking surprise arrives the girls way, Kerry encounters a music producer and a chance of a lifetime. In the meantime, after her boyfriend makes a surprise visit, Zara confesses her sextracurricular activities to him. New roommates Joanna and Andrea enter the house.

videos.title: Rocky Road
videos.overview: At a runway show, Jodie receives a modeling opportunity, and she is driven to show that it is not essential to be ultra-thin to succeed. In the meantime tensions rise between the new and old roommates when Joanna and Andrea arrive.

videos.title: Chicken Scratch
videos.overview: After Zara ditches Aimee at the club, and takes part in trashing the house, the other girls in the house become fed up with Zara's behavior.

videos.title: A Little Ditty About Steve & DeAnn
videos.overview: In DeAnn's case a kiss is not just a kiss, particularly when Steve kisses another woman, which painfully ends their relationship.

videos.title: Lord of Lies
videos.overview: It appears that all the girls are pitted against Jodie, as wall-to-wall drama in the house escalates. On another note, by traveling to Nashville Kerry attempts to tune up her music career. Jodie decides to leave the house prematurely.

videos.title: Happy Ending
videos.overview: Before the roommates attempt to reconcile broken friendships as they anticipate their exit from the house, a flirty Zara rarifies the girls' attempt to stage a charity fund-raising event.

videos.title: Shrink Wrapped
videos.overview: All the women through out the season return to the house and get together with a psychologist to analyze their past behavior, which doesn't sit well with Ty and Aimee. Also: Ripsi asks for Kerry's forgiveness.

videos.title: Outrageous & Unseen
videos.overview: Aimee, Ty, Zara, Leslie, & Ripsi showcase highlights and unseen footage from the first season; three of the housemates prepare to leave for the Bad Girls Road Trip.

videos.title: Bad Company
videos.overview: Seven all new “bad girls” swarm in on Los Angeles and try to coexist with one another in the same luxurious abode. But the battle lines are drawn when they realize there aren't enough freebies to share.

videos.title: Battle Lines
videos.overview: After two distinguishable competing groups start to take form, the women cool down their malicious spitefulness when a studly local man arrives.

videos.title: Spilled Milk
videos.overview: The women dish on one another---literally---when tensions between Neveen and Darlen boil over, resulting in a fierce food fight.

videos.title: Music & Lyric
videos.overview: As Lyric tries to hit all the right notes in her pursuit of music-industry success, the other "bad girls" seemingly find some harmony of their own.

videos.title: Pop Off!
videos.overview: Tanisha continually puts Cordelia down, but things become more tense when Cordelia regains her confidence.

videos.title: Prank Wars Part 1: Party Girls Strike Back
videos.overview: A battle rages as two household groups, the Hyenas and the Party Girls, start playing pranks on each other. Meanwhile, Cordelia's flirting with another man are causing issues with her fiancé.

videos.title: Prank Wars Part 2: Mark Your Territory
videos.overview: A flood of foul pranks ensues when two bad girl factions battle for household control. When songstress Lyric returns she is appalled by all of the off-note behavior.

videos.title: Prank Wars Part 3: The Phat Lady Sings!
videos.overview: Tanisha and Jennavecia clash over juice. The drama gets juicier when the roomies' juvenile escapades exasperate Lyric, who decides to leave the house.

videos.title: Love Conquers All
videos.overview: To help her cope with a shattered romance, Cordelia hits the bottle. In the meantime, the other "bad girls" offer support to Darlen as her drinking intensifies.

videos.title: Return of the Juice: Death of the Juice
videos.overview: Tanisha and Jennavecia use pranks to climb their way to the top. Darlen contemplates her status in the Party Girls after having received a sobriety award.

videos.title: Sucker Punched
videos.overview: Tanisha and Jennavecia take responsibility for their actions. Meanwhile, Cordelia is fed up with Scott and worries that dumping Taylor was a mistake.

videos.title: Taken for a Ride
videos.overview: An eruptive conflict revolves around Jennavecia, as Darlen considers turning to the other clique. Meanwhile, the ladies attempt to throw their first work party.

videos.title: Cordelia and the Chamber of Secrets
videos.overview: Jennavecia fakes being sick to get out of going to a meeting with Craig. She quits her job. Cordelia misses her boyfriend and regrets her decision to break up with him. Meanwhile, a new roommate (Andrea) arrives.

videos.title: Bad Riddance
videos.overview: Jennavecia quits her job and must leave the house; Cordelia emerges as the new leader of the Party Girls.

videos.title: With Friends Like These...
videos.overview: Hanna and Tanisha confront Neveen regarding her judgmental behavior. An ex-roommate badmouths Cordelia to Scott and Cordelia is looking for someone to blame.

videos.title: A Threesome... And Then Some
videos.overview: Cordelia and Andrea grow tighter, and their friendship just might progress to an interesting new level; the girls get slinky when they throw a lingerie bash

videos.title: Disorderly Conduct
videos.overview: Household tension and cliquish abuse push Andrea to the breaking point. Elsewhere, Tanisha throws a slumber party in hopes of uniting the women

videos.title: The Ugly Drunkling
videos.overview: Drunken Cordelia becomes an emotional wreck and vocalizes her deep-seated "ugly girl" complex. Tensions continue to rise between Cordelia and Andrea, and Cordelia's past is revealed to the Hyenas, who use every opportunity to exploit it, forcing Cordelia to alienate the other girls. Andrea vents via an online blog that may come back to haunt her.

videos.title: Ghouls Gone Wild
videos.overview: Darlen takes her frustrations out on an annoying club patron. Cordelia decides to stop drinking and seeks help from her housemates.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: Andrea's boyfriend Josh visits the house and repulses all the girls, especially jealous Cordelia. When one of the girls leaves her MySpace blog unattended, the stage is set for a colossal confrontation.

videos.title: Happy Trails
videos.overview: Andrea gets upset after the other girls give her a hard time for what she wrote in her diary and decides to leave the house. Meanwhile, the girls go out to a bar and get in a bar fight. Tanisha gets arrested.

videos.title: Pimp Down
videos.overview: As the end of their "bad girl" reign draws nigh, the ladies decide that heavy-partying time is in order. But unforeseen dramas develop, and the women deal with one of their own behind bars.

videos.title: All Bad Things Must Come to an End
videos.overview: Tanisha is still angry with the other girls about her stay in jail. The girls all say a tearful good-bye at the airport.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Star Jones hosts this reunion edition, in which the women reassemble to reflect on Season 2's dramas, tantrums and brawls and takes viewer questions.

videos.title: Breaking and Evening
videos.overview: Seven new Bad Girls break into their new home and waste no time ganging up on their least favorite roommate. The first night out proves to be a disaster when the girls get bounced from several clubs for their bad tempers.

videos.title: Boston Tea Party
videos.overview: Whitney and Kayla get into a physical fight and end their friendship. The girls go to a strip club, but Kayla drinks too much and falls unconscious.

videos.title: The Naked Truth
videos.overview: Tiffany reaches her limit with Kayla and abandons her neutral position in the house. Amber B., Tiffany and Ailea deal with drama from their new hook ups.

videos.title: The Tipping Point
videos.overview: The girls are asked to promote a lingerie shop in their underwear to earn money. Kayla is later removed from the mansion for brawling with Amber M.

videos.title: Popping In!
videos.overview: Bad Girl vet, Tanisha, teams up with the Ambers to prank the other girls. Whitney and Amber M. get into a heated argument after attending a surfing event.

videos.title: Who Is This Bitch?
videos.overview: Upon her arrival, Kayla's replacement, Ashley, feels unwanted. Later on, the girls organize a gambling event, which inspires them to go to Las Vegas.

videos.title: What Happens in Vegas...Airs on TV
videos.overview: The Bad Girls head to the Las Vegas Strip for some naughty fun. Ashley disassociates herself from the Ambers and becomes the fifth member of the Fab 5.

videos.title: This Is NOT the Amber Show
videos.overview: Back from Vegas, the mansion is divided more than ever. Amber B. pushes many of the girls to their breaking point, which results in a huge confrontation

videos.title: Ailea of the Storm
videos.overview: The Ambers attempt to make up with the others, but their efforts are challenged when Kayla returns. Meanwhile, Ailea juggles two men at the same time.

videos.title: Make a RUN for the Border
videos.overview: The Bad Girls are treated to a wild holiday in Cancun, where drama arises during a bikini contest. Whitney and Ailea get into a rowdy fight with Amber M.

videos.title: The Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Police intervene after the fight and Whitney is removed from the house. The girls later confront Ailea about her bad attitude, causing her to leave as well.

videos.overview: The Ambers host a controversial clip show with shocking new scenes, bloopers, and never-before-seen footage from the third season of the Bad Girls Club.

videos.title: All's Well That Ends Bad
videos.overview: Back from Cancun, Sarah's relationship ends as her boyfriend learns of her infidelity. The girls celebrate their last night by trashing the mansion.

videos.title: Unresolved Issues
videos.overview: All eight Bad Girls return to clear up their dirty laundry and physically work out some unresolved issues. This reunion special is hosted by Perez Hilton.

While the other girls resist various attempts at house dominance by Natalie, Kate quickly discovers her inner Bad Girl when she stands up to the house dictator. Kendra and Natalie's budding alliance is threatened when the two come to blows during an explosive argument.

videos.overview: When Flo sets out to woo a woman, an appalled Amber's disapproval of Flo's same-sex desire ignites a fiery confrontation that might change the house dynamics for good. Meanwhile, the ladies pose for a photo shoot, and they reassemble with the baddest "bad girl".
